context: Evaluates correct setup of Vue I18n using createI18n with globalInjection enabled, proper locale initialization from localStorage with a Spanish default, and implementation of a useLocale composable that wraps useI18n for locale switching and persistence. The i18n instance must be exported as a singleton for app installation.

checklist.name: createI18n config
checklist.description: createI18n is called with globalInjection: true, a fallbackLocale of 'en', and message catalogs for both 'en' and 'es' locales loaded from JSON files.

checklist.name: localStorage locale init
checklist.description: The initial locale is read from localStorage under the key 'lang'. When no value exists, the locale defaults to 'es' and 'es' is immediately written back to localStorage.

checklist.name: useLocale composable
checklist.description: useLocale calls useI18n with useScope: 'global' to access the global locale ref, and returns currentLocale, availableLocales, and setLocale.

checklist.name: setLocale function
checklist.description: setLocale updates locale.value to the provided code string and persists the code to localStorage under the key 'lang'.

checklist.name: availableLocales array
checklist.description: availableLocales is a static array containing exactly two objects: { code: 'es', label: 'Español' } and { code: 'en', label: 'English' }.
